|game_text=Slip on the Decipher card ''Tatooine: City Outskirts''<br />'''Light:''' Your starfighters may deploy here (for -1 Force), and take off and land here for free. Incom Corporation and Koensayr Manufacturing may deploy here.<br />'''Dark:''' May not deploy to Bespin, Coruscant, Dagobah, Dantooine, Endor, Hoth, or Subjugated Planet. Rebel Cell sites are immune to Revolution and No Escape. Limit one copy on table.
